📑 2027 PERSONAL INCOME TAX (PAYE / APIT) BRACKETS & FULL TAX HUB

Today's 2027 Budget does three big things to Personal Income Tax: (1) raises the tax-free threshold from Rs. 1.80M to Rs. 1.95M/year (Rs. 162,500/month), (2) reintroduces the 12% bracket right after the 6% slab (replacing the harsh jump from 6% straight to 18%), and (3) widens all subsequent slabs from Rs. 500,000 to Rs. 600,000 so the 36% top rate only starts above Rs. 5.20M/year (~Rs. 433,333/month)!

1. New Tax-Free Salary Limit
Rs. 162,500 / mo
Up from Rs. 150,000/mo (Rs. 1.95M/year vs. Rs. 1.80M/year in 2025/26, and Rs. 1.20M/year before April 2025).
2. New Monthly Tax Savings Range
Rs. 750 – Rs. 15,750 / mo
Saves Rs. 9,000 to Rs. 189,000 per year! Combined with the 2025 relief, total monthly savings reach Rs. 4,250 to Rs. 36,250/mo.
3. Top 36% Rate Threshold Pushed Out
Rs. 5.20M / yr (~Rs. 433k/mo)
Previously kicked in at Rs. 4.30M/yr (~Rs. 358,333/mo). Reintroduces the 12% tier and widens slabs to Rs. 600,000.

    10% Ports & Airports Development Levy removed on imported newsprint and solar storage batteries (Rs. 350M annual relief).

    Current $3B IMF bailout expires; special Cabinet committee evaluating a successor IMF deal amid $4.4B fuel import bill.

  6. April 1, 2027 — CESS 25% Cut & Tourism Levy Abolished

    CESS cut by 25% across 800 HS import lines (-Rs. 10B), Tourism Development Levy abolished (-Rs. 40M), and new PAYE tax year kicks in.
